title: Kirkpatrick dodged a meeting with Borland

tellings.quote: But uh they wanted me to go and talk to Kurt Patrick and Kurt Patrick ducked me.

plain: In 2023, Dylan Borland, a whistleblower, says he was asked to talk to Sean Kirkpatrick, then head of AARO, the Pentagon office set up to look into reports of unexplained objects, and that Kirkpatrick 'ducked' him. Borland tells Michels this from his own experience, meaning the official in charge never heard him out.
